text:
jess (support): prod alert - multiple customers reporting 504/gateway timeouts to the hosted inference endpoint (model: rwd-26b). Started ~11:12 UTC, still happening. Customers saw retries, and a few billing auth 403s in the logs.

sanjay (oncall): on it. linking pager and runbook: https://internal/r/runbooks/autoscale-triage. Any immediate error patterns from logs?

jess (support): errors show upstream timeouts at the gateway, then 502/504 to clients. Example trace: 
```
2024-06-18T11:12:34Z gateway timeout -> 504
upstream: POST /v1/generate 503 from inference-pool-1
auth: token-rotate failure 401 -> then 403 for some tenants
metrics: keda_scaledobject_trigger_metric dropped to 0 for ~30s
```

michaela (eng-sre): suspicious that the KEDA metric dropped during the token rotation. Could be scaledobject polling/debounce or the metric source failing auth and returning empty. Can we get the ScaledObject and HPA status + keda-operator logs?

ryan (infra): grabbing resources. running: 
```
kubectl -n inference get scaledobject,deploy,hpa -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/keda-operator --since=20m
kubectl -n inference get events --field-selector type=Warning
```

deploy-bot: Alert posted to #incidents: PROD-504 spike (SLO breach) - alert_id=PRD-504-8891 :rotating_light:

ryan (infra): scaledobject for rwd-26b shows: pollInterval: 30s, cooldownPeriod: 300s, and trigger authRef pointing to secret rotated 11:10 UTC. HPA shows desired replicas spiked but pods stuck in ContainerCreating for ~40s, readiness probe failing.

michaela (eng-sre): readiness probe failures during start usually mean model init is slow — but why did the metric drop earlier? If the trigger source fails auth it reports 0 and KEDA scales down, then a burst comes and HPA+KEDA try to scale up but warm init + preflight makes it miss SLOs. Hypothesis: token rotate briefly invalidated metric collector -> scaledobject returned 0 -> scale-down or no extra prewarm -> later burst timed out.

alex (platform): I see a related change in the auth-service: we deployed a short-lived key rotation at 11:09 that briefly rejected some metric queries from the keda metric adapter. We intended to stagger but the job overlapped.

jess (support): customers reported higher 5xx right after 11:12, consistent. Repro steps requested by support: which logs/commands should I ask them to capture?

michaela (eng-sre): ask them for request-id from gateway, exact timestamps, and tenant id. Also request a stacktrace from the gateway and the API response body. From our side collect keda-operator logs, metric-adapter logs, scaledobject status and HPA events for that tenant. Quick commands to paste: 
```
kubectl -n inference describe scaledobject <name>
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o yaml | grep -A4 <deployment-name>
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/metric-adapter --since=30m | egrep "<tenant-id>|error|401|403"
```

ryan (infra): immediate mitigations: 1) revert auth rotation job to retry with backoff, 2) temporarily bump scaledobject pollInterval to 5s for the impacted model (short-term), 3) increase HPA minReplicas to avoid full scale-to-zero during rolling auth changes. Thoughts?

michaela (eng-sre): agree on mitigation 2 & 3 as short-term. For 1, need coordination with security. Also add a fallback in the metric adapter: on auth error return last-known-value instead of 0 for N seconds to avoid transient scale-downs. Will file a ticket: #INF-5632.

alex (platform): filing change request for auth rotation window + canary on metric-adapter behavior. Will loop in security.

jess (support): escalation note for customers: apologizing, explaining we traced to a token rotation that briefly impacted autoscaling metrics and caused scale-up lag -> SREs applying mitigations. ETA for full fix?

michaela (eng-sre): short-term mitigations deploy in next 15-30m (patch to metric-adapter + raise minReplicas). Longer term fix (fallback logic + rotation canary) tracked in INF-5632, PLANNED for next sprint.

sanjay (oncall): action items: 
- ryan: revert/adjust rotation schedule (10m)
- ryan/michaela: bump minReplicas + temporary pollInterval (15m)
- michaela: PR for metric-adapter fallback (follow-up ticket)
- jess: customer comms template + collect requested repro info
I'll update incident status in 30m.

jess (support): sending initial comms now, collecting customer request-ids. :white_check_mark:

michaela (eng-sre): capturing logs and attaching to incident. If anyone sees persistent 5xxs after mitigations, ping me directly.

ryan (infra): starting the short-term rollouts now. will post rollout status.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: metric-adapter patch v1.2.1 -> inference-ns (by ryan)

jess (support): thanks everyone. I'll update customers once mitigations complete and we have more timeline for the permanent fix.
